message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large red letters. At the center, a man’s head and upper torso are shown from a slightly low angle, positioned as if he is submerged chest-deep in brown water. He has light brown skin, short dark hair, and wears a light green snorkeling mask and a bright orange life vest over a white collared shirt. He holds a green and white snorkel tube in his left hand. The mask’s lenses reflect a submerged landscape with a small orange fish and a flooded building.

Behind the man, the background is a flat, murky brown. In the top corners, two small dark bird silhouettes fly against a light gray sky. To the right of the man, bold black text reads: "RAPOR BANJIR ANIES." Smaller black text below states: "PROGRAM PENGENDALIAN BANJIR GUBERNUR JAKARTA ANIES BASWEDAN KEDODORAN. ANGGARANNYA BERKURANG, PELAKSANAANNYA BERANTAKAN." Other headlines at the top include "MAJU-MUNDUR PALAPA RING TIMUR" and "KISRUH RUMAH JENDERAL DI CIJANTUNG." A barcode, QR code, and publication details are at the bottom.
